question: $\overrightarrow{\mathbf{A}}=2 \hat{i}+x \hat{j}-4 \hat{\mathbf{k}}$ ও $\vec{B}=y \hat{i}+6 \hat{j}-8 \hat{k}$ । x ও y এর মান কত হলে $\overrightarrow{\mathbf{A}}$ ও $\overrightarrow{\mathbf{B}}$ পরস্পর সমান্তরাল হবে?
explanation:
$\begin{aligned} & \overrightarrow{\mathrm{A}} \times \overrightarrow{\mathrm{B}}=0 \\ & \text { বা, }\left|\begin{array}{llc}\hat{\mathrm{i}} & \hat{\mathrm{j}} & \hat{\mathrm{k}} \\ 2 & \mathrm{x} & -4 \\ \mathrm{y} & 6 & -8\end{array}\right|=0 \\ & \text { বা, } \hat{i}(-8 x+24)-\hat{j}(-16+4 y)+\hat{k}(12-x y)=0 \hat{i}+0 \hat{j}+0 \hat{k}\end{aligned}$


শর্তমতে,

$\begin{array}{lc}-8 x+24=0 & \text { অথবা, }-16+4 y=0 \\ \text { বা, }-8 x=-24 & \text { বা, } 4 y=16 \\ \therefore x=3 & \therefore y=4\end{array}$
